content.text:
## Myocardial infarction — CPRD Read codelist

**Scope:** Codes indicating a current myocardial infarction (MI), including recurrent and postoperative MI, and explicitly recorded current complications of acute MI. Codes were identified using CPRD term searches and Read-code hierarchy searches.

Read codes and term variants are retained exactly as returned by CPRD. A code recorded in the past does not, by itself, establish that MI is current at a later assessment date.

### 1. Acute myocardial infarction and diagnostic synonyms

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G30 | Acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-1 | Attack - heart |
| G30-2 | Coronary thrombosis |
| G30-3 | Cardiac rupture after acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-4 | Heart attack |
| G30-5 | MI - acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-6 | Thrombosis - coronary |
| G30-7 | Silent myocardial infarction |
| G30-98 | Coronary thrombosis |
| G30-99 | Myocardial Infarction |
| G300 | Acute anterolateral myocardial infarction |
| G301 | Acute anterior myocardial infarction |
| G3010 | Acute anteroapical infarction |
| G3011 | Acute anteroseptal myocardial infarction |
| G301z | Anterior myocardial infarction NOS |
| G302 | Acute inferolateral myocardial infarction |
| G303 | Acute inferoposterior infarction |
| G304 | Acute posterior myocardial infarction |
| G305 | Acute lateral myocardial infarction |
| G306 | True posterior myocardial infarction |
| G307 | Acute subendocardial infarction |
| G3070 | Acute non-Q wave infarction |
| G3071 | Acute non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction |
| G308 | Acute myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G309 | Acute Q-wave infarct |
| G30B | Acute myocardial infarction of posterolateral wall |
| G30X | Acute transmural myocardial infarction of unspecif site |
| G30X0 | Acute ST segment elevation myocardial infarction |
| G30y | Other acute myocardial infarction |
| G30y0 | Acute atrial infarction |
| G30y1 | Acute papillary muscle infarction |
| G30y2 | Acute septal infarction |
| G30yz | Other acute myocardial infarction NOS |
| G30z | Acute myocardial infarction NOS |
| G31y1 | Microinfarction of heart |
| Gyu34 | [X]Acute transmural myocardial infarction of unspecif site |

The coronary-thrombosis synonyms above belong to the acute-MI code `G30`; **`G312` (coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI) is excluded**.

### 2. Subsequent myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G35 | Subsequent myocardial infarction |
| G350 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of anterior wall |
| G351 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G353 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of other sites |
| G35X | Subsequent myocardial infarction of unspecified site |
| Gyu35 | [X]Subsequent myocardial infarction of other sites |
| Gyu36 | [X]Subsequent myocardial infarction of unspecified site |

### 3. Myocardial infarction with current complications

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G36 | Myocardial infarction with complication |
| G360 | Haemopericardium as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G361 | Atrial septal defect as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G362 | Ventricular septal defect as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G363 | Rupture of cardiac wall without haemopericardium as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G364 | Rupture of chordae tendinae as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G365 | Rupture of papillary muscle as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G366 | Thrombosis of atrium, auricular appendage, and ventricle as current complications following acute myocardial infarction |
| Gyu31 | [X]Other current complicatns following acute myocard infarct |

### 4. Postoperative myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G38 | Postoperative myocardial infarction |
| G380 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction of anterior wall |
| G381 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G382 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction other sites |
| G383 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction unspec site |
| G384 | Postoperative subendocardial myocardial infarction |
| G38z | Postoperative myocardial infarction, unspecified |

### 5. Treatment explicitly documenting acute myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| 889A | Diabetes mellitus insulin-glucose infusion in acute myocardial infarction |

### Additional MI-related codes requiring qualification

These are **not included in the strict current-MI codelist above**. Positive ECG findings do not establish whether infarction is acute or old; “aborted MI” does not unambiguously establish completed myocardial infarction.

| Read code | CPRD term | Qualification |
|---|---|---|
| 323 | ECG: myocardial infarction | Timing not specified |
| 3233 | ECG: antero-septal infarct. | Timing not specified |
| 3234 | ECG:posterior/inferior infarct | Timing not specified |
| 3235 | ECG: subendocardial infarct | Timing not specified |
| 3236 | ECG: lateral infarction | Timing not specified |
| 323Z | ECG: myocardial infarct NOS | Timing not specified |
| G3110 | Myocardial infarction aborted | Include only if the phenotype explicitly includes aborted MI |
| G3110-1 | MI - Myocardial infarction aborted | Include only if the phenotype explicitly includes aborted MI |

**Other exclusions:** old/healed MI and personal history of MI (`G32` and its variants; `14A3`, `14A4`, `14AH`, `14AT`); family history; suspected MI; preinfarction/impending infarction; unstable angina or acute coronary syndrome without explicit MI; post-MI syndrome, post-infarct angina and post-infarction pericarditis; administrative quality-indicator codes; and nonspecific mural thrombosis (`G30A`). These do not independently indicate a current MI.

attachments.b3e4a3a10b70ee3983f4d2f1e18ab5fd:
## Myocardial infarction — CPRD Read codelist

**Scope:** Codes indicating a current myocardial infarction (MI), including recurrent and postoperative MI, and explicitly recorded current complications of acute MI. Codes were identified using CPRD term searches and Read-code hierarchy searches.

Read codes and term variants are retained exactly as returned by CPRD. A code recorded in the past does not, by itself, establish that MI is current at a later assessment date.

### 1. Acute myocardial infarction and diagnostic synonyms

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G30 | Acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-1 | Attack - heart |
| G30-2 | Coronary thrombosis |
| G30-3 | Cardiac rupture after acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-4 | Heart attack |
| G30-5 | MI - acute myocardial infarction |
| G30-6 | Thrombosis - coronary |
| G30-7 | Silent myocardial infarction |
| G30-98 | Coronary thrombosis |
| G30-99 | Myocardial Infarction |
| G300 | Acute anterolateral myocardial infarction |
| G301 | Acute anterior myocardial infarction |
| G3010 | Acute anteroapical infarction |
| G3011 | Acute anteroseptal myocardial infarction |
| G301z | Anterior myocardial infarction NOS |
| G302 | Acute inferolateral myocardial infarction |
| G303 | Acute inferoposterior infarction |
| G304 | Acute posterior myocardial infarction |
| G305 | Acute lateral myocardial infarction |
| G306 | True posterior myocardial infarction |
| G307 | Acute subendocardial infarction |
| G3070 | Acute non-Q wave infarction |
| G3071 | Acute non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction |
| G308 | Acute myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G309 | Acute Q-wave infarct |
| G30B | Acute myocardial infarction of posterolateral wall |
| G30X | Acute transmural myocardial infarction of unspecif site |
| G30X0 | Acute ST segment elevation myocardial infarction |
| G30y | Other acute myocardial infarction |
| G30y0 | Acute atrial infarction |
| G30y1 | Acute papillary muscle infarction |
| G30y2 | Acute septal infarction |
| G30yz | Other acute myocardial infarction NOS |
| G30z | Acute myocardial infarction NOS |
| G31y1 | Microinfarction of heart |
| Gyu34 | [X]Acute transmural myocardial infarction of unspecif site |

The coronary-thrombosis synonyms above belong to the acute-MI code `G30`; **`G312` (coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI) is excluded**.

### 2. Subsequent myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G35 | Subsequent myocardial infarction |
| G350 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of anterior wall |
| G351 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G353 | Subsequent myocardial infarction of other sites |
| G35X | Subsequent myocardial infarction of unspecified site |
| Gyu35 | [X]Subsequent myocardial infarction of other sites |
| Gyu36 | [X]Subsequent myocardial infarction of unspecified site |

### 3. Myocardial infarction with current complications

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G36 | Myocardial infarction with complication |
| G360 | Haemopericardium as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |
| G361 | Atrial septal defect as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |

| G363 | Rupture of cardiac wall without haemopericardium as current complication following acute myocardial infarction |

| Gyu31 | [X]Other current complicatns following acute myocard infarct |

### 4. Postoperative myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| G38 | Postoperative myocardial infarction |
| G380 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction of anterior wall |
| G381 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction of inferior wall |
| G382 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction other sites |
| G383 | Postoperative transmural myocardial infarction unspec site |
| G384 | Postoperative subendocardial myocardial infarction |
| G38z | Postoperative myocardial infarction, unspecified |

### 5. Treatment explicitly documenting acute myocardial infarction

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| 889A | Diabetes mellitus insulin-glucose infusion in acute myocardial infarction |

### Additional MI-related codes requiring qualification

These are **not included in the strict current-MI codelist above**. Positive ECG findings do not establish whether infarction is acute or old; “aborted MI” does not unambiguously establish completed myocardial infarction.

| Read code | CPRD term | Qualification |
|---|---|---|
| 323 | ECG: myocardial infarction | Timing not specified |
| 3233 | ECG: antero-septal infarct. | Timing not specified |
| 3234 | ECG:posterior/inferior infarct | Timing not specified |
| 3235 | ECG: subendocardial infarct | Timing not specified |
| 3236 | ECG: lateral infarction | Timing not specified |
| 323Z | ECG: myocardial infarct NOS | Timing not specified |
| G3110 | Myocardial infarction aborted | Include only if the phenotype explicitly includes aborted MI |
| G3110-1 | MI - Myocardial infarction aborted | Include only if the phenotype explicitly includes aborted MI |

**Other exclusions:** old/healed MI and personal history of MI (`G32` and its variants; `14A3`, `14A4`, `14AH`, `14AT`); family history; suspected MI; preinfarction/impending infarction; unstable angina or acute coronary syndrome without explicit MI; post-MI syndrome, post-infarct angina and post-infarction pericarditis; administrative quality-indicator codes; and nonspecific mural thrombosis (`G30A`). These do not independently indicate a current MI.

The coronary-thrombosis terms above are included because they map to the acute-MI code `G30`. The distinct code `G312` explicitly describes thrombosis **without** MI and is excluded.

### Additional recording explicitly indicating acute MI

| Read code | Term |
|---|---|
| 889A | Diabetes mellitus insulin-glucose infusion in acute myocardial infarction |

### ECG evidence — retain separately from confirmed current MI

These codes record ECG evidence of infarction but do **not reliably establish whether the infarction is current or historical**. They should require corroboration for a strict current-MI definition.

| Read code | Term |
|---|---|
| 323 | ECG: myocardial infarction |
| 3233 | ECG: antero-septal infarct. |
| 3234 | ECG:posterior/inferior infarct |
| 3235 | ECG: subendocardial infarct |
| 3236 | ECG: lateral infarction |
| 323Z | ECG: myocardial infarct NOS |

**Excluded:** old/healed MI and personal-history codes; family history; suspected, impending or aborted MI; negative ECG findings; post-MI syndrome, post-infarction pericarditis and angina without a current MI diagnosis; generic acute coronary syndrome/ischaemia; administrative and historical procedure codes. `G30A` (“Mural thrombosis”) is also excluded because its recorded term alone does not establish current MI.

**Timing:** A diagnostic code identifies MI at the recorded event; it does not imply that the patient continues to have an acute MI indefinitely afterward.

### Current MI with complications and MI-specific treatment

| G30-3 | Cardiac rupture after acute myocardial infarction |

| Gyu31 | [X]Other current complicatns following acute myocard infarct |
| 889A | Diabetes mellitus insulin-glucose infusion in acute myocardial infarction |

### ECG evidence of MI — supplementary codes

These codes record an ECG interpretation indicating infarction, but **do not reliably distinguish current from previous MI**. Include them when capturing all recorded evidence of MI; require corroborating evidence if the phenotype must strictly identify a current event.

| Read code | Term |
|---|---|
| 323 | ECG: myocardial infarction |
| 3233 | ECG: antero-septal infarct. |
| 3234 | ECG:posterior/inferior infarct |
| 3235 | ECG: subendocardial infarct |
| 3236 | ECG: lateral infarction |
| 323Z | ECG: myocardial infarct NOS |

**Excluded from the current-MI codelist:** old/healed MI and personal or family history; suspected, impending or aborted MI; ECG explicitly reporting old MI or no MI; post-MI syndrome, post-infarction pericarditis and post-infarct angina; nonspecific acute coronary syndrome/ischaemia; administrative codes; and isolated mural thrombosis (`G30A`), which does not itself establish MI.

The coronary-thrombosis entries above are included because they are alternative terms for the acute-MI code `G30`; `G312` (“Coronary thrombosis not resulting in myocardial infarction”) is excluded.

### Current MI with complications and MI-specific treatment

| 889A | Diabetes mellitus insulin-glucose infusion in acute myocardial infarction |

### ECG evidence of MI — supplementary codes

These codes record an ECG interpretation indicating infarction, but **do not reliably distinguish current from previous MI**. Include them when capturing all recorded evidence of MI; require corroborating evidence if the phenotype must strictly identify a current event.

| Read code | Term |
|---|---|
| 323 | ECG: myocardial infarction |
| 3233 | ECG: antero-septal infarct. |
| 3234 | ECG:posterior/inferior infarct |
| 3235 | ECG: subendocardial infarct |
| 3236 | ECG: lateral infarction |
| 323Z | ECG: myocardial infarct NOS |

**Excluded from the current-MI codelist:** old/healed MI and personal or family history; suspected, impending or aborted MI; ECG explicitly reporting old MI or no MI; post-MI syndrome, post-infarction pericarditis and post-infarct angina; nonspecific acute coronary syndrome/ischaemia; administrative codes; and isolated mural thrombosis (`G30A`), which does not itself establish MI.

The coronary-thrombosis entries above are included because they are alternative terms for the acute-MI code `G30`; `G312` (“Coronary thrombosis not resulting in myocardial infarction”) is excluded.
